name: SpineFrame
description:
SpineFrame is a audit-grade runtime that gives AI agents auditable provenance — every tool call, every piece of evidence, every decision is traced, policy-checked, and cryptographically signed.
Signed evidence chains, compliance pipelines, and tool-call tracing that survives regulatory scrutiny.
